best_for: Music collectors who want to find rare or out-of-print recordings by browsing other people's shared folders, and who accept a volunteer-run network.
description:
SoulseekQt is the current desktop client for Soulseek, a file sharing network from Soulseek LLC that carries no ads and no spyware. The older Soulseek NS client is no longer developed, so this is the one that gets new builds.

Chat rooms, a search engine and a search correlation system help you find people who like the same music you do. To share your own files, open Options, File Sharing and click Share Folder. A folder download from search results takes only the files that were shown; to get the rest, choose Browse Folder and download from that person's share. Note that usernames are recycled after 30 days without a login, unless you hold privileges.

points.title: Free, built on sharing
points.text: SoulseekQt is a free client for a peer-to-peer network where you search and browse what other users share and chat in rooms. Donations are made from the Support Soulseek button inside the app.

points.title: You are responsible for what you share
points.text: The rules say Soulseek does not condone sharing copyrighted material and was built to spread music from independent artists. Download and share only what you have the right to.

points.title: No guarantees
points.text: The rules describe the service as unsupported. Access is a privilege that can be revoked at any time, admins can disconnect anyone without notice, and each IP address may connect up to five clients.

points.title: Mac needs macOS 13
points.text: The download page says the Mac build requires macOS 13 or higher. It is a universal disk image for Intel and Apple silicon. Windows gets a 64-bit machine-wide installer.

points.title: Linux is behind
points.text: The official site offers a Linux AppImage, but it is dated 2024-06-30 while the Windows and Mac builds are dated 2026-04-30. This site lists only Windows and macOS.

points.title: Old client still around
points.text: The original Windows client, Soulseek NS, is still linked from the download page for people who prefer it. The Windows listing here keeps 3 versions of SoulseekQt; macOS lists only the current one.
